title: What Happens If You Drive With Low Tire Pressure
hook: Stop driving on soft flat tires.

script.narration: Stop driving on soft flat tires. It destroys your fuel economy instantly.
script.visual_search: low tire pressure warning on car dashboard

script.narration: Under-inflated tires create more friction against the pavement. This extra drag forces your engine to burn extra fuel just to maintain speed, generating dangerous excess heat.

description:
Curious what happens when you ignore your tire pressure? Discover the hidden science of friction and heat that drains your gas tank and ruins your tires.

Quick science and tech facts explained simply for everyday life.
